Aviation Ground Stop Linked to System Upgrade Push

A nationwide ground stop was implemented due to a system failure, with Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy suggesting the disruption might have been shorter if L3Harris had identified the issue earlier. The ground stop occurred as Duffy was pushing for rapid upgrades to aviation systems. The incident has led to questions regarding the Trump administration's handling of the situation.
